about_the_game:
Survive the Cursed Voyage

Trapped aboard a cursed cargo ship, you and your crew must keep the ship running, scavenge for supplies, and survive against horrors lurking in the shadows. But as the voyage continues, the nightmares only grow stronger.

Gameplay Features

  • 🔧 Co-Op Survival – Work with your crew to repair systems, fend off creatures, and scavenge for resources.

  • ⚡ Dynamic Ship Systems – Manage power, navigation, and fuel while keeping the ship afloat.

  • 👁 Procedural Horrors – Unpredictable threats emerge from the sea—or from within the ship.

  • 🏚 Scavenge & Survive – Search through dark corridors and cargo containers for crucial supplies.

  • 🎙 Proximity Voice Chat – Communicate in-game, but be careful—something may be listening.

Key Features

  • 🌊 Tense Atmosphere – Navigate a ship where darkness hides more than just shadows.

  • 🐙 Relentless Creatures – Face evolving threats that grow stronger over time.

  • 🤝 Teamwork is Essential – Repair, strategize, and survive together—or perish alone.

  • 🔄 Highly Replayable – Procedurally generated layouts and events ensure each voyage is unique.

Will You Survive?

As reality twists and fractures, your only hope is to keep the ship moving—but will you ever truly escape?

A co-op survival horror experience where teamwork, resource management, and terror collide.

The ship is waiting. Are you ready?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
